scope: Logical app planes, v5 experiment boundaries and one recorded development example. Full 80-case validation completed; economic gates not passed; confirmation not run.

figures.name: system-planes
figures.caption:
Solid arrows: v5 benchmark flow. Dashed connection: existing live-app sandbox samples, outside the v5 trial.
Channel3 is a catalog source. Native receipts are linked samples, not extra simulated sales. Planes are responsibilities, not independent microservices.

figures.name: evaluation-design
figures.caption:
Future evaluation outcomes do not feed back into the agent. Its revisions use shared observed market data and its previous choices.
Confidence intervals resample seed clusters, not individual shoppers. A win requires positive mean/uncertainty gates, not a selected successful seed.

figures.name: recorded-review
figures.caption:
This is one development market. The full-run gain must not be attributed solely to the day-80 decision.
The first-choice control shares the earlier choices but repeats the initial campaign; its cheaper one-call cost is included. Repeatable gains remain unproven.

figures.name: paypal-live-path
figures.caption:
Six service workflows have recorded sandbox readback; unpaid invoices and unactivated subscription offers are not sales.
No production funds, no webhook integration claim, and no new native payment in v5. API integration evidence does not prove PayPal profit.
